tasks.short: Prepare the payroll close pack and check that issued salary payments match Rabobank statements.

today.trigger: A regular payroll or an additional payment run finishes and the relevant bank statement becomes available.
steps: Export the final payroll totals, payment list and journal reports from AFAS.
Download Rabobank statements and identify the salary batches.
Match batch amounts and references, investigating returns, missing payments and timing differences.
Assemble the period-end pack in Excel and save supporting records.
Explain unresolved differences to the Accountant or Controller and obtain close approval.
systems: AFAS Profit Payroll and general ledger
drudgery: Downloading and renaming the same reports every period
Copying totals between spreadsheets
Repeatedly checking payments that already match
today.time_sinks: Finding the right final run, obtaining batch detail and explaining timing differences between payroll issue and bank settlement.

lenses.faster: Import final AFAS reports and structured bank statements once, then match them by batch reference and amount. Spreadsheet copying and routine matching disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A final payroll run and a new bank statement trigger reconciliation automatically. Missing statements and unmatched items create exceptions with named owners.
lenses.ambitious: Check every regular and additional salary batch promptly, including returned payments. Give employees affected by failed payments a faster resolution.
lenses.joy: Stop hunting through exports and highlighting matching rows. Spend time resolving the few differences that could leave someone unpaid.
lenses.options: Show possible explanations for each difference, such as settlement delay, returned payment or duplicate batch. Evidence determines the resolution.
lenses.altitude: I maintain the matching rules and review control performance instead of rebuilding the close spreadsheet.
reach: Prepare the Accountant's payroll payment reconciliation evidence.
Provide the Controller with a consistent payroll close status.

tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a technically matching batch still hides an employee payment problem, and take responsibility for resolving it.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: amounts, references and statuses support reproducible matching. AI can help build the rules, but a model should not decide whether money reconciles; the close approval remains human.

in_practice.trigger: An approved AFAS run is final and the bank data covering its settlement date has arrived.
steps: Read final payroll and payment records through validated exports or available connectors, recording run identifiers.
Import Rabobank camt.053 statements and available batch detail, rejecting duplicate imports.
Match salary batches and individual transactions where detail exists; distinguish settled, returned and outstanding payments.
Produce a close pack containing totals, source links and unresolved differences.
Route exceptions for investigation and submit the completed pack for close approval.
in_practice.human_gate: The Payroll Specialist resolves exceptions; the Controller or designated Accountant approves each close pack. A batch total alone is not evidence that every employee received payment.
data_needed: Final payroll run identifiers, employee payment records and batch totals
Bank references, settlement dates, batch detail and return records
Approved matching rules and timing tolerances
Close calendar and exception owners
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint payroll close register containing source identifiers, matches, exceptions, rule versions and approval records.

evidence.claim: Rabobank supports structured end-of-day camt.053 statements and documents statement formats.
Matching AFAS payment records to bank data with a custom rules service is plausible; Noordhaven's identifiers and batch detail have not been tested.
The 65% labour saving and 2 times elapsed speedup are planning estimates, assuming usable structured data and few exceptions.

risks: Bank batches may lack individual payment detail, allowing a matching total to conceal failed employee payments.
Duplicate imports or provisional payroll reports could create a false reconciliation.
Payroll and bank exports need restricted access under AVG/GDPR.
This task shares data preparation with balancing payroll accounts; count that saving only once.
research_questions: Do AFAS and Rabobank retain a common batch reference across regular and additional runs?
Can Noordhaven obtain individual batch and return detail through its existing Rabobank service?
Across three recent closes, how much time was spent matching clean items versus resolving genuine differences?

tasks.short: Run salaries in AFAS, prepare the Rabobank payment batch and issue employees' payslips.

today.trigger: Payroll cut-off arrives or an approved additional payment is required.
steps: Check that employee changes and variable pay inputs have been approved and entered.
Run provisional payroll in AFAS and review changes in gross pay, net pay and deductions.
Resolve errors and obtain approval for the final payroll.
Generate the payment file and arrange Rabobank authorisation.
Issue final payslips and check payment and delivery exceptions.
drudgery: Checking whether every input owner has finished
Repeating the same control comparisons
Manually moving payment files and checking output status
today.time_sinks: Late shift allowances or overtime inputs, unexplained net-pay changes and waiting for payroll or bank approval.

lenses.faster: Automate input completeness checks, prior-period comparisons and output preparation around AFAS. AFAS continues to calculate salaries and deductions.
lenses.autonomous: The payroll calendar triggers readiness checks and provisional processing after approved inputs are complete. Finalisation and bank release wait for explicit approval.
lenses.ambitious: Check every employee's pay movement against approved changes before payday. Prioritise starters' first salaries and unresolved shift-pay inputs.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated exports and status chasing. Keep the judgement involved in making sure people receive correct pay on time.
lenses.options: Compare the approved main run with a separately approved additional run for late corrections. Show workload, timing and affected employees.
lenses.altitude: I own the payroll control design, cut-off discipline and exception process rather than manually advancing every processing step.
reach: Help HR Administrators prevent incomplete starter and contract changes.
Prepare salary payment readiness information for Finance.

tasks.human_edge: Understand unusual pay movements, challenge incorrect input and protect employee trust when a payment needs urgent correction.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: a proposed workflow coordinates input checks, AFAS processing, output preparation and bank hand-off. Calculations stay deterministic, and each final payroll and payment batch requires approval.

in_practice.trigger: Scheduled payroll preparation begins; provisional processing starts only after required inputs pass readiness checks.
steps: Check approved changes, payroll population and missing variable inputs against the cut-off list.
Start provisional AFAS processing through supported automation and wait for completion.
Apply deterministic checks for unexplained pay movements, duplicate employees, changed IBANs and deduction exceptions.
Present the control summary for payroll approval before AFAS finalisation.
Generate the final payment file and payslips, then hand the batch to authorised Finance staff for Rabobank release.
Monitor output and bank statuses, escalating failures without automatically resending payments.
in_practice.human_gate: The Payroll Specialist approves each payroll after reviewing controls, with an independent reviewer under the company mandate. An authorised Finance approver releases each Rabobank batch; approval is invalidated if its contents change.
systems: Proposed payroll workflow and rules service
data_needed: Approved employee changes and variable pay inputs
Applicable transport or warehouse CAO and payroll configuration
Previous and provisional payroll results
Verified IBAN changes and approval mandates
Run identifiers, output statuses and bank acknowledgements
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS processing records plus a restricted approval register linking each approved run to its payment file, bank authorisation and payslip output.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports queued payroll processing, payment-file generation and payslip generation; its guidance warns that automatically following processing with approval removes the review step.
Rabobank salary batch processing depends on full approval and can encounter payment failures.
The proposed checks and 40% labour saving are estimates beyond existing AFAS automation; approval waits limit elapsed speedup to an estimated 1.4 times.

risks: Incorrect CAO assignment or missing approved shift inputs can produce a technically successful but wrong payroll.
Unverified IBAN changes and automatic retries could cause fraud or duplicate payments.
Finalisation must wait for the review of completed provisional results.
Staffing agencies normally pay their own flex workers; agency invoices must not enter Noordhaven's employee salary batch.
research_questions: Which processing and output steps already run automatically in Noordhaven's AFAS configuration?
Where do approved overtime and shift allowances originate, and can their completeness be checked electronically?
Can the workflow enforce independent approval and bind approval to an unchanged payment file?
How often do late inputs or approval waits determine payday readiness?

tasks.short: Send HR and Finance the agreed pay and benefits reports for each site and payroll period.

today.trigger: Payroll is final, the monthly reporting deadline arrives or HR or Finance requests a summary.
steps: Collect AFAS payroll, deduction and employer-cost data.
Check whether the nightly Power BI extract includes the final payroll.
Group amounts by site, department and pay or benefits category.
Check totals and explain significant movements.
Send the appropriate reports to approved HR and Finance recipients.
drudgery: Refreshing recurring spreadsheets
Reformatting the same site summaries
Preparing different copies for different recipients
today.time_sinks: Reconciling report definitions, waiting for the final-run extract and tailoring access without exposing individual salaries.

lenses.faster: Generate standard tables from agreed definitions and a verified final-run snapshot. Repeated spreadsheet assembly and formatting disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A successful refresh containing the final payroll triggers validation and publication to established recipients. Failed checks hold publication and alert me.
lenses.ambitious: Provide consistent pay and benefits costs for Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo, with clear explanations of changes. Separate employee payroll from agency labour costs.
lenses.joy: Stop rebuilding tables and replying to questions about inconsistent totals. Spend time explaining what changed and helping managers act.
lenses.options: Offer site, department and pay-component views from the same checked dataset. Use separate, labelled scenario reports for proposed CAO or staffing changes.
lenses.altitude: I define payroll measures, access rules and quality checks instead of producing each report by hand.
reach: Maintain payroll reporting definitions with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
Supply checked employer-cost inputs to the FP&A Analysts.
Support the Compensation and Benefits Specialist with benefits-cost summaries.

tasks.human_edge: Explain movements in context and prevent readers from treating accounting changes or aggregate payroll trends as evidence about employee performance.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: recurring reports use structured data and agreed formulas. Optional llm_step commentary can draft explanations from checked aggregates, but numbers and routine publication need no model.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly AFAS extract refresh completes and includes the approved final payroll run.
steps: Verify refresh status, payroll run identifiers and reporting period.
Calculate approved measures and reconcile totals to final AFAS reports.
Generate recipient-specific site and department summaries with privacy controls.
Publish routine reports to restricted destinations and notify approved recipients.
Hold failed checks and route unusual movements or new reporting requests to the Payroll Specialist.
in_practice.human_gate: Approve definitions, access and recipient lists before activation and whenever they change. Routine reports publish without individual approval after checks pass; any model-written explanation is reviewed before publication.
data_needed: Final payroll results and extract timestamps
Site, department and cost-centre mappings
Approved measure definitions and prior-period comparators
Recipient permissions and aggregation thresholds
Separately identified agency invoice data if total labour costs are requested
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted reporting register containing dataset version, validation results, report definitions, publication destinations and exceptions.

evidence.claim: AFAS report sets can be generated automatically and saved or distributed following payroll processing or approval.
Validated publication from Noordhaven's existing extract is plausible, but its final-run markers and permissions need testing.
The 65% labour saving and 2.5 times elapsed speedup assume mostly recurring reports; nightly refresh remains a timing constraint.

risks: A successful nightly refresh can still contain provisional or incomplete payroll data.
Small groups or detailed pay components can reveal individual salaries despite aggregation.
Combining payroll, accounting accruals and agency invoices without agreed definitions can double-count labour costs.

Changes to employee data-processing arrangements may require OR consent; assess the actual arrangement with HR using [SER privacy guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/belangrijke-themas/privacy).
research_questions: Which requested reports are recurring, and which still require judgement or bespoke analysis?
Does the existing extract identify final payroll runs and preserve correction history?
Can recipient permissions and small-group suppression be enforced and tested before automatic publication?

tasks.short: Reconcile the payroll control accounts and explain outstanding salary, tax and pension balances.

today.trigger: Payroll journal entries post, related payments settle or Finance begins month close.
steps: Collect opening balances, payroll journals and related bank or payable entries.
Reconcile net salary, payroll tax, pension and relevant clearing accounts.
Identify legitimate outstanding liabilities and unexplained differences.
Agree any corrective entries with the Accountant.
Document the closing balances and obtain account sign-off.
systems: AFAS Profit Payroll, general ledger and accounts payable
drudgery: Rebuilding opening-to-closing balance schedules
Matching already identified payments again
Copying outstanding items into the next month's workbook
today.time_sinks: Tracing journal mappings, separating due-but-unpaid liabilities from errors and resolving corrections spanning several periods.

lenses.faster: Generate each account's opening balance, movements and closing balance automatically. Reuse payment matches from the payroll close pack.
lenses.autonomous: New payroll journals and settlement records refresh the reconciliations. Unmapped postings and overdue liabilities trigger an exception.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a current view of payroll liabilities between month closes. Investigate old clearing items before they accumulate.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive ledger matching and workbook roll-forwards. Keep the investigation that explains why a balance exists.
lenses.options: Show the balance under settlement-date and payroll-period views. Separate timing differences, mapping errors and missing payments.
lenses.altitude: I maintain account mappings, evidence standards and ageing rules rather than checking every ledger line manually.
reach: Prepare the Accountant's payroll control-account schedules.
Provide the Controller with payroll liability ageing and recurring error analysis.

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether an outstanding balance represents a real obligation, a timing difference or an error requiring a financial correction.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: account roll-forwards and approved matching rules are checkable. People retain ownership of accounting treatment, corrective postings and close sign-off.

in_practice.trigger: Payroll journals, related payable entries or bank settlement records change.
steps: Read ledger movements and reuse the verified payment dataset from payroll reconciliation.
Build roll-forwards for approved payroll control accounts using versioned mappings.
Match liabilities to settlements and carry forward identifiable outstanding items.
Flag unexplained balances, overdue obligations and mapping changes with supporting entries.
Prepare proposed corrections and the sign-off pack for the Accountant and Controller.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant approves and posts corrective entries; the Controller or delegated reviewer signs off each account reconciliation. The service cannot clear a difference merely to force a zero balance.
systems: AFAS Profit general ledger, Payroll and accounts payable
data_needed: Opening balances and complete ledger movements
Payroll journal mappings and final-run identifiers
Salary, tax and pension liability schedules
Matched bank settlements and payment due dates
Approved accounting policies and outstanding-item owners
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted Finance close register linking account roll-forwards, outstanding items, proposed entries and approvals to source transactions.

evidence.claim: AFAS provides payroll journal reports whose content depends on processing status and journal configuration.
A custom rules service can plausibly prepare account roll-forwards and settlement matches; automatic judgement of accounting treatment is not established.
The 50% labour saving and 1.7 times elapsed speedup assume stable mappings and exclude savings already credited to payment reconciliation.

risks: Correctly outstanding tax or pension liabilities could be mistaken for errors if payment deadlines are ignored.
A payroll journal can balance overall while using incorrect liability or cost accounts.
Corrections spanning periods may require a reconciliation bridge rather than direct equality between reports.
Savings overlap with period-end payment reconciliation unless shared preparation is allocated once.
research_questions: Which payroll accounts does Payroll reconcile, and which remain entirely with Finance?
Are journal mappings and opening balances reliable enough to reproduce recent signed-off reconciliations?
What proportion of differences follows repeatable rules rather than requiring accounting judgement?

tasks.short: Correct earlier pay errors and apply approved backdated salary or CAO increases.

today.trigger: An employee reports a pay error, HR approves a backdated change or an applicable CAO update takes effect.
steps: Collect the original payroll, approved change and relevant effective dates.
Determine the affected employees, periods and pay components.
Enter the correction in AFAS and run the retroactive calculation.
Check gross-to-net changes and consequences for pension, tax and journal entries.
Approve the correction for a regular or additional run and explain it to affected employees.
systems: SharePoint CAO documents and approved change records
drudgery: Tracing the same change across several pay periods
Preparing before-and-after comparisons
Drafting repeated explanations of retroactive adjustments
today.time_sinks: Establishing entitlement and effective dates, checking leavers and year-crossing corrections, and distinguishing corrections from separate additional payments.

lenses.faster: Build the affected-population list and before-and-after control pack automatically. AFAS calculates the approved retroactive change.
lenses.autonomous: An approved structured change triggers a provisional correction proposal. A model may extract fields from a document, but those fields require verification.
lenses.ambitious: Check every affected employee, including leavers, whenever a CAO change is implemented. Find missed corrections before employees have to ask.
lenses.joy: Remove period-by-period spreadsheet calculations and repeated letter drafting. Keep fair resolution of pay errors and clear employee conversations.
lenses.options: Compare permitted payment dates, regular versus additional runs and cash requirements. Entitlement and effective dates remain fixed by the approved decision.
lenses.altitude: I maintain correction controls and approved CAO rules rather than manually reconstructing every adjustment.
reach: Help the Compensation and Benefits Specialist assess implementation costs for approved CAO changes.
Help HR Administrators identify contract changes that repeatedly create payroll corrections.

tasks.human_edge: Interpret disputed entitlement, distinguish the two CAOs and handle sensitive overpayments or corrections without undermining employee trust.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: the workflow gathers evidence, identifies scope, prepares an AFAS correction and drafts an explanation. An optional llm_step extracts document fields; people approve entitlement and AFAS performs the calculation.

in_practice.trigger: An approved pay correction or backdated change enters the payroll change register.
steps: Read the approved change, effective date and applicable CAO; route ambiguous documents for human interpretation.
Identify affected employees and periods, including leavers and relevant historic records.
Prepare the AFAS change through a supported interface or controlled import and calculate provisional results.
Compare original and corrected pay, pension, tax and journal results, checking for duplicate corrections.
Present the scope, financial effects and employee explanation for approval.
After approval, process through the authorised payroll route and link downstream tax and pension corrections.
in_practice.human_gate: The Payroll Specialist verifies each correction's scope and calculation; HR or Compensation and Benefits confirms disputed entitlement. Negative adjustments and overpayment recovery require an explicitly approved handling decision.
systems: SharePoint approved CAO and change records
data_needed: Approved change and authoritative effective date
Historic pay, hours, contracts and CAO assignments
Original and provisional corrected payroll results
Pension and tax treatment for affected periods
Correction identifiers and prior adjustment history
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS change history plus a restricted correction register containing approval evidence, affected periods, before-and-after values and downstream filing references.

evidence.claim: AFAS documents retroactive corrections arising from CAO updates, pay mutations, parameter changes and employee master-data changes.
AFAS documents posting pensionable back pay to the relevant historic period, including corrections affecting former employees.
Document extraction and automated control-pack preparation are proposed; the 45% labour saving and 1.5 times elapsed speedup are unmeasured estimates.

risks: A wrong effective date or CAO population can multiply an error across many employees and periods.
Year-crossing and pensionable adjustments need the correct processing route.
A model could misread a CAO clause or treat an unapproved request as authority.

Using AI to decide pay entitlement or employment terms requires an EU AI Act assessment of intended purpose; approval alone does not determine classification. See [European Commission guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act).
research_questions: What proportion of adjustments arrives as structured, approved changes rather than disputed emails?
Can the proposed workflow reproduce recent corrections, including leavers and year-crossing cases?
Which warehouse CAO provisions require custom AFAS configuration rather than a standard update?
Who owns approval of overpayment recovery and disputed entitlement?

tasks.short: Check and submit the Dutch payroll tax return and track its receipt and payment.

today.trigger: Payroll is final and the relevant loonaangifte deadline approaches, or a correction is needed.
steps: Generate the payroll tax return in AFAS from approved payroll results.
Review employee details, contribution codes, totals and correction periods.
Resolve validation issues and approve the return for submission.
Submit through AFAS and check returned statuses and messages.
Arrange the approved tax payment with Finance and retain filing and payment evidence.
systems: AFAS Profit Payroll and communication service
drudgery: Checking filing status repeatedly
Maintaining parallel deadline lists
Copying return totals and payment references into close records
today.time_sinks: Resolving unusual contribution treatment, historic corrections, communication failures and differences between return totals and accounting records.

lenses.faster: Prepare completeness checks, movement comparisons and the approval pack automatically. AFAS creates and submits the return.
lenses.autonomous: Final payroll triggers return preparation, and returned statuses trigger follow-up. Submission waits for approval; unresolved messages remain visible until closed.
lenses.ambitious: Track every filing, correction and related payment in one register. Catch rejected messages or missing payments before the deadline.
lenses.joy: Remove reminder maintenance and repeated status checks. Keep the technical judgement needed for unusual tax and insurance treatment.
lenses.options: Show permitted correction routes for the affected period with sources and payment consequences. A person selects the route when treatment is uncertain.
lenses.altitude: I maintain filing controls, rule updates and evidence standards rather than manually chasing each return through its statuses.
reach: Prepare payroll tax payment evidence for the Accountant.
Give the Controller a reliable view of payroll tax obligations and unresolved filing issues.

tasks.human_edge: Own the correctness of fiscal treatment and know when to obtain specialist advice rather than rely on a successful technical validation.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: preparation, validation, approval, AFAS submission and status monitoring form a controlled workflow. Tax amounts and filing formats use maintained deterministic software; a model does not calculate or approve tax.

in_practice.trigger: AFAS payroll approval completes for the filing period, or an approved correction enters the filing queue.
steps: Confirm the employer number, filing period, final payroll population and correction dependencies.
Generate the AFAS return and run technical, completeness and prior-period comparison checks.
Prepare the approval pack with unexplained changes and applicable source references.
Following human approval, submit through AFAS's configured communication route.
Record receipt or rejection messages and route failures without blind resubmission.
Prepare payment instructions for Finance and link bank settlement evidence to the filing.
in_practice.human_gate: The Payroll Specialist or authorised deputy approves each return and correction before submission. Finance separately approves payment; a received status confirms technical receipt rather than fiscal correctness.
systems: AFAS Profit Aangiftecockpit and communication service
Belastingdienst filing channel configured in AFAS
data_needed: Final payroll records and employer payroll-tax number
Current official tax rules and AFAS update status
Employee contribution codes and approved contract facts
Filing deadlines, correction history and communication statuses
Verified payment details, references and bank settlement records
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS communication records plus a restricted filing register containing the approved return version, receipt messages, exceptions and payment evidence.

evidence.claim: AFAS can automatically send a prepared payroll tax return and receive rejection or received statuses; its documentation distinguishes technical checks from fiscal validity.
The Belastingdienst publishes the current year's payroll-tax handbook and revision information.
The proposed monitoring and control pack could reduce labour by 35%; an estimated 1.3 times elapsed speedup reflects existing software automation and external response waits.

risks: A technically received return can still contain incorrect fiscal treatment.
Outdated rules, contract classifications or contribution codes can produce repeated errors.
Submission retries and payment preparation must check existing statuses to prevent duplicates.
An expired communication certificate or unresolved rejection can block filing despite a completed payroll run.
research_questions: How much current effort concerns manual administration versus substantive tax judgement?
Are filing statuses and error messages accessible through supported exports or interfaces?
Can controls reproduce historic correction handling and distinguish receipt from fiscal review?
Is there an authorised deputy who can approve and resolve filings when the sole Payroll Specialist is absent?

tasks.short: Check pension and benefits changes, prepare required submissions and resolve rejected records.

today.trigger: An employee joins, leaves or changes relevant terms, or a pension or benefits submission falls due.
steps: Collect approved employee, contract and benefits changes from AFAS and HR.
Check scheme membership, effective dates and required fields.
Prepare pension submissions or provider forms using the applicable route.
Verify deductions and employer contributions against payroll.
Submit approved records and resolve returned errors or missing confirmations.
systems: Relevant pension or benefits provider channels, to be confirmed
drudgery: Re-entering employee details in forms
Checking the same required fields repeatedly
Chasing provider confirmations and rejected records
today.time_sinks: Determining the correct scheme, dealing with unsupported provider formats and resolving mismatches in dates, membership or pensionable pay.

lenses.faster: Populate provider records from approved AFAS changes and validate required fields once. Use AFAS pension delivery where the actual provider supports it.
lenses.autonomous: Approved lifecycle changes trigger draft records, and the filing calendar triggers pension preparation. Rejected or unconfirmed submissions create follow-up tasks.
lenses.ambitious: Check that every eligible starter is enrolled and every relevant change reaches the provider. Resolve discrepancies before they affect coverage or contributions.
lenses.joy: Remove form copying and confirmation chasing. Keep helping employees understand their arrangements and resolving difficult cases.
lenses.options: Present allowed scheme choices and contribution effects where employees have a choice. HR approves eligibility and employees make their own elections.
lenses.altitude: I maintain scheme mappings, data requirements and provider confirmation controls rather than completing every form manually.
reach: Help HR Administrators check benefits completeness for starters and leavers.
Support the Compensation and Benefits Specialist with provider discrepancies and contribution checks.
Prepare administrative payroll evidence for HR-owned UWV processes without taking over medical or reintegration decisions.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous scheme membership and coverage questions, respect employee choices and recognise when a case belongs with HR, the provider or a specialist.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: provider routes and exceptions vary, so the workflow prepares and validates records before approval. Optional llm_step extraction can handle forms; eligibility and contributions use approved rules.

in_practice.trigger: An approved AFAS lifecycle or benefits change occurs, or the provider submission calendar reaches its preparation date.
steps: Identify the applicable scheme and provider route using approved membership mappings.
Populate draft records from authorised AFAS fields, excluding medical narratives.
Validate membership dates, required fields, deductions and employer contributions.
Present the submission and ambiguous cases for Payroll and, where needed, HR approval.
Send through AFAS UPA where configured and supported, or the provider's verified alternative route.
Record provider confirmations, resolve rejections and reconcile submitted contributions.
in_practice.human_gate: The Payroll Specialist approves each submission batch; HR or Compensation and Benefits resolves ambiguous eligibility. Employee elections require recorded employee choice, and statutory insurance reporting is not treated as a private insurance enrolment.
systems: AFAS Profit and UPA where applicable
Verified pension and benefits provider channels
data_needed: Approved employee and contract changes
Actual scheme eligibility rules and effective dates
Provider identifiers, membership numbers and delivery specifications
Pensionable pay, deductions and employer contributions
Recorded employee elections and provider response records
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS pension communication records plus a restricted benefits register linking approved changes, submitted versions, provider responses and resolved exceptions.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports Uniforme Pensioenaangifte for participating providers after activation and configuration of employer, provider and communication settings.
Automated preparation for other benefits providers is plausible but depends on Noordhaven's actual schemes and available delivery routes.
The 50% labour saving and 1.6 times elapsed speedup assume mostly standard changes and usable provider responses; these are planning estimates.

risks: The actual pension providers and schemes are unknown; UPA support must be confirmed rather than assumed.
Dutch unemployment insurance reporting and health-insurance contributions do not follow the US-style enrolment implied by the original task wording.

Medical records must remain outside payroll forms and model inputs; employers may process only permitted absence information. See [Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens guidance](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/werk-en-uitkering/zieke-werknemers/registratie-in-een-verzuimsysteem).
Wet verbetering poortwachter case ownership remains with HR and the relevant professionals; this workflow only supplies authorised administrative payroll data.
research_questions: Which pension and benefits schemes apply to transport, warehouse and office employees, and who owns membership decisions?
Which providers support AFAS delivery, and which still require manual forms or portal entry?
Can provider confirmations be matched to submitted employee records and contribution totals?
How much of this task is genuinely performed by Payroll rather than HR Administrators or Compensation and Benefits?

role.altitude: Payroll control owner: design the route from approved employee changes to correct pay, reconciled accounts and evidenced filings, while resolving exceptions and maintaining CAO rules.
reach: Prepare payroll control-account schedules and filing evidence for the Accountant.
Maintain pay and benefits reporting definitions with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
Provide checked employer-cost data and approved-change scenarios to FP&A.
Support Compensation and Benefits with CAO implementation checks and provider reconciliations.
Help HR Administrators prevent incomplete first-pay inputs and repeated contract-change errors.
role.ceiling_note: These seven tasks cover 482.8 hours, about 30.2% of the supplied 1,600-hour role year. The estimates imply about 244 gross hours released annually, worth roughly EUR 13,429 at EUR 55/hour, before implementation, maintenance and reconciliation overlap; this is capacity, not cash savings. Today's workflows are inferred hypotheses requiring confirmation, and elapsed speedups include processing and approval waits, so they are not the inverse of labour savings. The remaining role time is unassessed. One Payroll Specialist still needs a trained deputy, independent payment approval and specialist support for disputed CAO, tax and pension treatment. Keep model use limited to checked extraction and drafting; assess any expansion into employment decisions under the [European Commission's AI Act guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act), and assess OR rights for changed personnel data arrangements using [SER guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/belangrijke-themas/privacy).
skills_to_grow: Translate both applicable CAOs into versioned payroll rules and effective-date controls.
Configure AFAS processing, reports and supported integrations with the HRIS Analyst.
Design reconciliations, duplicate prevention and approvals tied to specific output versions.
Investigate exceptions across payroll, bank, ledger, tax and pension records.
Apply AVG/GDPR data minimisation, access controls and retention rules.
Verify model-extracted fields and maintain clear boundaries around employment decisions.
Measure actual handling time, elapsed time, error rates and recurring causes before claiming savings.
role.ambitious_version: Run a payroll service that checks every approved change, flags incomplete first-pay inputs before cut-off, monitors failed salary payments and records every filing and provider response. Use the released capacity to prevent recurring errors across the three sites and make starters' first 90 days smoother through reliable pay and clear explanations. Track first-pay accuracy and correction resolution alongside HR's 90-day outcomes, without claiming payroll alone determines retention.
